text:
```artifact
Test Case TC-001: VCMCL03-1 (positive)
  Preconditions: A Chemist/Lab with ID "existing_id" exists in the system.
  Steps:
    1. Navigate to Edit/Update Chemist/Labs screen.
    2. Enter "existing_id" in Chemist/Lab ID field and submit.
  Expected: Chemist/Lab details (Name, Address, Contact Details) are displayed and modification/deletion functionality is enabled.

Test Case TC-002: VCMCL03-2 (negative)
  Preconditions: None.
  Steps:
    1. Navigate to Edit/Update Chemist/Labs screen.
    2. Enter "non_existent_id" in Chemist/Lab ID field and submit.
  Expected: System displays error message "Chemist or Lab does not exist".

Test Case TC-003: VCMCL03-3 (negative)
  Preconditions: Chemist/Lab with ID "existing_id" has open prescription requests.
  Steps:
    1. Navigate to Edit/Update Chemist/Labs screen.
    2. Enter "existing_id" in Chemist/Lab ID field and submit.
    3. Click Delete button.
  Expected: System displays error message "Chemist or Lab has open Prescription Requests - cannot delete".

Test Case TC-004: VCMSYM02 (positive)
  Preconditions: None.
  Steps:
    1. Navigate to Add Symptom Code screen.
    2. Enter "valid_symptom_code" in Symptom Code field and "valid_description" in Symptom Description field.
    3. Submit form.
  Expected: Symptom is added successfully.

Test Case TC-005: VCMSYM03 (negative)
  Preconditions: None.
  Steps:
    1. Navigate to Edit/Update Symptom screen.
    2. Enter "non_existent_symptom_code" in Symptom Code field and submit.
  Expected: System displays error message indicating symptom does not exist.

Test Case TC-006: VCMSYM03 (positive)
  Preconditions: Symptom with Code "existing_symptom_code" exists in system.
  Steps:
    1. Navigate to Edit/Update Symptom screen.
    2. Enter "existing_symptom_code" in Symptom Code field and submit.
    3. Modify Symptom Description to "updated_description".
    4. Submit modification.
    5. Delete symptom.
  Expected: Symptom details displayed, modification saved, symptom deleted successfully.

Test Case TC-007: VCDPA02 (positive)
  Preconditions: New patient created valid username/password.
  Steps:
    1. System displays Patient Registration screen.
  Expected: Screen contains fields: Patient Id (generated), Name, Age, Sex, Address, Contact details.

Test Case TC-008: VCMPA01 (positive)
  Preconditions: Patient profile exists with initial details.
  Steps:
    1. Navigate to Update Patient Profile screen.
    2. Modify Name to "new_name".
    3. Submit update.
  Expected: Patient profile updated with new Name.
```
